entities.summary: Manav Kaul is an Indian theatre director, playwright, author, actor and filmmaker. He won the Filmfare OTT Award 2023 for Best Actor for the short film Phir Kabhi apart from being nominated for the same award in 2024 and 2021. He was also nominated for the Filmfare Award for Best Supporting Actor for his role in the films Tumhari Sulu (2017) and Saina (2021).
